items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: that's my first job with three pieces. So after I did so well, then my brother and Eddie Garland, Sugar John and a bunch of them, that's when they first went to Chicago.

ctx.x: And we had a three piece band down on Gidresson Alley, I mean the man around the place was Gidresson Alley, it was upstairs at the nightclub, and that's my first job with three pieces. So after I did so well, then my brother and Eddie Garland, Sugar John and a bunch of them, that's when they first went to Chicago.
